vo.text: A changing electrical signal will make it move.
vo.speak: A changing electrical signal will make it move.

vo.text: Inside, a coil sits in the field of a permanent magnet.
vo.speak: Inside, a coil sits in the field of a permanent magnet.

vo.text: The audio signal sends alternating current through that coil.
vo.speak: The audio signal sends alternating current through that coil.

vo.text: The current reverses, so the magnetic force reverses too.
vo.speak: The current reverses, so the magnetic force reverses too.

vo.text: The coil pulls the cone inward, then pushes it outward.
vo.speak: The coil pulls the cone inward, then pushes it outward.

vo.text: Follow the cone, not the waveform.
vo.speak: Follow the cone, not the waveform.

vo.text: As the cone moves out, it compresses the air in front.
vo.speak: As the cone moves out, it compresses the air in front.

vo.text: As it moves back, it leaves a region of lower pressure.
vo.speak: As it moves back, it leaves a region of lower pressure.

vo.text: Those pressure variations travel outward as sound.
vo.speak: Those pressure variations travel outward as sound.

vo.text: Electrical variations become mechanical motion, and motion becomes sound.
vo.speak: Electrical variations become mechanical motion, and motion becomes sound.
